name: assembly-newsh2-273
summary: A ground rock wall (a row of 2x2 pieces: newsh2-273 at the left end, newsh2-275 repeated, newsh2-277 at the right end) with a big purple octagonal armour hatch set in each piece. Behind the hatches along the top runs a purple band of panels, and between each pair of hatches a lighter purple housing fills the V-shaped gap; below them lies a bed of grey boulders with beige stones, deep dark crevices between them. Shape language: hard, chamfered purple plates stacked in height (hatch above housing above band) set among round, faceted, matte boulders.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours
